title: Checkbox
description: A basic CheckboxGroup whose label renders a legend that names the group, with independent CheckboxField rows stacked in a CheckboxList, using a shared name with distinct values and defaultChecked for the initial state. Each checkbox is a Tab stop and toggles with Space or a click. Use it as the starting point for a simple uncontrolled list of options, such as notification settings, before adding descriptions, cards, or shared group state.
